summary: Approve an agent's plan before it runs: its steps, what it changes, and how much it may do alone.
intent: Block: the go / no-go on an agent's plan. The steps (AgentPlan, editable while pending), what the plan expects to change (ChangeSummary), how far the agent may go without asking (AutonomyDial), and one decision: Approve plan, Request changes with a note, or Reject.
useWhen: an agent proposes a multi-step plan and a person must approve it before anything runs
set the agent's autonomy for this run at the moment of approval
send the plan back with a note instead of editing it yourself
doNotUseWhen: one action that needs an OK — ApprovalCard
the plan while it runs — AgentPlan or RunDetail
review what the agent already changed — ChangeReview
autonomy in settings, with no plan — AutonomyDial

planTitle.note: AgentPlan card title, e.g. "Add rate limiting to the public API".

steps.note: AgentPlan steps: { id, label, tool?, target?, note?, needsApproval? }[].

onStepsChange.note: (steps) => void. AgentPlan's Save step, Remove and Add step while pending. Without it the steps are read-only.

agent.note: Who proposed it, e.g. "Backend agent". Lead line and AutonomyDial appliesTo.

changes.note: ChangeSummary items: { id, label, before, after, delta, direction, sentiment? }[].

changesPeriod.note: ChangeSummary period line, e.g. "Expected after the run".

autonomyOptions.note: AutonomyDial stops; default AUTONOMY_STOPS (ask · risk · tell · run).

decision.note: Anything but pending locks the plan and the dial and shows the outcome as a kit Alert.

decisionNote.note: Line in the outcome Alert, e.g. "by you · 14:02".

onApprove.note: ({ autonomy, steps }) => void. Approve plan, the view's one solid primary.

onRequestChanges.note: (note) => void. Request changes opens a note field; Send request (or ⌘/Ctrl+Enter) sends it, Escape cancels.

layout: the plan beside a stack of ChangeSummary over AutonomyDial in layout-split--primary; the decision row under both
the block is its own inline-size container; below --grid-breakpoint-md (64rem) of block width it is one column, and below 40rem the decision buttons take the full row

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
the decision is a section labelled by its h3 "Your decision"; Approve plan is described by the line that says how many stops wait for your OK at the chosen autonomy
the note is a kit Field + Textarea labelled "What should change?"; it takes focus when opened, Escape cancels and returns focus to Request changes, ⌘/Ctrl+Enter sends
the outcome is a kit Alert (status, or alert when rejected)
the steps, their Edit / Remove buttons and the autonomy radio group are AgentPlan's and AutonomyDial's own controls

doNot: Do not rebuild PlanReview from a local plan card and buttons; import the block
Only one solid primary: Approve plan. Do not pass AgentPlan its own onAccept here
Do not add a Save button to the AutonomyDial; Approve hands back the chosen stop
snippet: <PlanReview planTitle="Add rate limiting to the public API" agent="Backend agent" target="acme/api" steps={steps} onStepsChange={setSteps} changes={changes} onApprove={({ autonomy, steps }) => run(autonomy, steps)} onRequestChanges={sendBack} onReject={reject} />
